title: The Little Fox and the Glowing Acorn
originalStory: A little fox found a glowing acorn in the forest and followed its light to a new friend.
visualBible: Little Fox: small red fox, fluffy tail, bright eyes, no clothes. Glowing Acorn: shiny golden acorn, emits a soft light.

pages.text: Once upon a time, a little fox found a glowing acorn in the forest. It shined brightly under the moonlight. Curious, the fox picked it up with its tiny paws.
pages.illustrationScene: A little red fox with a fluffy tail holding a shiny golden acorn under a starry sky.

pages.text: The fox followed the acorn's light deeper into the forest. The trees seemed to whisper as the fox passed by. The glow led the fox to a sparkling stream.
pages.illustrationScene: The little fox walking through a forest, following the glowing acorn's light, with trees all around.

pages.text: There, by the stream, the fox met a friendly rabbit. The rabbit smiled and said, 'Thank you for finding my acorn!' They became good friends and played together in the forest.
pages.illustrationScene: The little fox and a friendly rabbit by a sparkling stream, smiling at each other, with the glowing acorn between them.
